lane:
بقش

بَقْشٌ _A certain kind of tree, called in Persian_ خُوشْ سَاىْ, (Sgh, K,) which means “ good in shade; ” [and also is applied to the _box-tree;_] as has been said before, voce بَقْسٌ, which may be the same: IDrd says that بَقْشٌ is a post-classical word. (TA.)

entries.text: البقش: شجر يقال له بالفارسية: خوش ساي.
